mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (student_id, class_id, enrollment_id, reg_id, pay_date, amount, pay_type, pay_method, operator_id, remark, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{enrollmentId}, #{regId}, #{payDate}, #{amount}, #{payType}, #{payMethod}, #{operatorId}, #{remark}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET student_id = #{studentId}, class_id = #{classId}, enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}, reg_id = #{regId}, pay_date = #{payDate}, amount = #{amount}, pay_type = #{payType}, pay_method = #{payMethod}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, refund_time = #{refundTime}, refund_operator_id = #{refundOperatorId} WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY pay_date DESC
